$comment: Cold-start-to-interactive budget for the Soter mobile app (issue #931). Read and enforced by scripts/measure-cold-start.js. See ../COLD_START_BUDGET.md before changing these numbers.
deviceProfile: Low-end reference device: Android 8.1 (API 27), 2 vCPU, 2048MB RAM emulator (see .github/workflows/mobile-cold-start-budget.yml's AVD config). Chosen to represent field devices, not development hardware.

phaseBudgetsMs.$comment: Informational targets for the phase breakdown in the report. Only totalMs + toleranceRatio above are enforced as a hard CI gate; these help attribute a regression to a phase during triage.

calibrationNote: Initial budget is a conservative starting estimate based on typical React Native cold-start times on 2GB-RAM Android 8-9 devices, not yet measured against this app's actual CI run. Recalibrate from the first several real cold-start-report.json runs once the workflow has run on main, then update lastCalibrated.
